_about: Every app event Nova can send. Each event in a line's markers must be listed here. 'does' is what the app should do on screen. tools/build_events.py builds the developers' reference sheet (EVENTS.md) from this list and the lines that use each event. 'cues' lists how a writer may phrase it in a script's [brackets]; the first is the one the preview's Events panel copies. 'scene' groups it in that panel.

line_end.does: Sent automatically when a line finishes. Use it to move to the next step.

highlight_shops.does: Highlight the shops on the home map ("See those shops?"): spotlight it and point the arrow at it.

highlight_home.does: Highlight the home on the map: spotlight it and point the arrow at it.

highlight_sticker_book.does: Highlight the sticker book in the room: spotlight it and point the arrow at it.

highlight_closet.does: Highlight the closet: spotlight it and point the arrow at it.

highlight_back_arrow.does: Highlight the back arrow ("Tap the back arrow, and let's go!"): spotlight it and point the arrow at it.

highlight_next_world_arrow.does: Highlight the arrow that rotates to the next world ("Tap the arrow to keep traveling through worlds"): spotlight it and point the arrow at it.

highlight_enter.does: Highlight the Enter button on the world selection screen: spotlight it and point the arrow at it.

clear_highlight.does: End the highlight: the spotlight and the arrow fade out together.

clear_spotlight.does: End only the spotlight: the spotlight fades, the arrow stays and blinks until the child taps the item (or until a later [Stop highlight]).

nova_exit.does: Nova leaves the screen; the scene stays for the child to explore and choose.

_rules: A highlight has two parts: the spotlight (a dark overlay with a cut-out around the item) and an arrow pointing at the item. They appear together.
A highlight stays until the script ends it, or until a new highlight replaces it. Finishing the line does not end it.
[Stop highlight] (clear_highlight): the spotlight and the arrow fade out together.
[Stop spotlight] (clear_spotlight): only the spotlight fades. The arrow stays and blinks until the child taps the item (or a later [Stop highlight]).
